name: Teaching Simulator: Elite Class
storyline: Jump into the world of teaching with Teaching Simulator: Elite Class. Help your students learn, improve, and graduate from primary school. Decorate your classroom to make learning more fun and exciting. Bring in new students, support your team, and keep your principal happy. Every choice you make affects your classroom, your school, and everyone around you.
